entries.text: Are you talking to yourself again?
entries.translation: 你又在自言自语了吗？

entries.text: No, not this time. I was talking to Pete.
entries.translation: 不，这次不是。我刚才在和皮特说话。

entries.text: He has a birthday coming up, but he told me not to tell anyone.
entries.translation: 他的生日快到了，但他让我别告诉任何人。

entries.text: From the way he was speaking, I don't think he likes cake or presents or fun.
entries.translation: 从他说话的方式来看，我觉得他不喜欢蛋糕、礼物或热闹。

entries.text: I don't care. I'm getting him a present.
entries.translation: 我不在乎。我会送他一份礼物。

entries.text: Do you know where I can buy something unique?
entries.translation: 你知道哪里可以买到独特的东西吗？

entries.text: You will definitely find something unique there.
entries.translation: 你在那里一定能找到独特的东西。

entries.text: Great. I'll go this weekend.
entries.translation: 太好了。我这个周末就去。

entries.text: Speaking of Pete's birthday, what else should I do?
entries.translation: 说到皮特的生日，我还应该做些什么？

entries.text: He'll never speak to you again.
entries.translation: 他再也不会和你说话了。

entries.text: How can I help you today?
entries.translation: 今天我能帮你什么？

entries.text: A friend told me about your store.
entries.translation: 一个朋友告诉我有你们这家店。

entries.text: Anna, this place is really unique.
entries.translation: 安娜，这个地方真的很独特。

entries.text: Here at Tanglewood Works, we focus on things that are handmade, reclaimed and recycled.
entries.translation: 在坦格尔伍德工坊，我们专注于手工、回收和再利用的物品。

entries.text: That is really good for the environment.
entries.translation: 那对环境真的很好。

entries.text: Local artists made all of these one-of-a-kind pieces.
entries.translation: 这些独一无二的作品都是本地艺术家制作的。

entries.text: Can I look around?
entries.translation: 我可以四处看看吗？

entries.text: Every time I try to make something, something goes wrong.
entries.translation: 每次我试着做点什么，总会出岔子。

entries.text: It's okay. Anna, everybody can make something.
entries.translation: 没关系，安娜，每个人都能做点东西。

entries.text: When I see something special that someone has thrown away, I can almost hear it talk.
entries.translation: 当我看到别人扔掉的特别物品时，我几乎能听见它在说话。
